message.title: Prosafe SE: Operational update   August 2026
message.body:
Oslo, 21 September 2026 - Fleet utilisation for August 2026 was 80%. 

All operating vessels delivered near 100% commercial uptime in August, with
Safe Eurus, Safe Notos, Safe Zephyrus and Safe Boreas operating at full
capacity. 

On 31 August, Safe Notos completed its legacy contract with Petrobras and
immediately commenced a new four-year firm period contract from 1 September,
supporting safety and maintenance operations offshore Brazil at significantly
improved terms.

Safe Caledonia remained in lay-up at Scapa Flow, UK, ahead of a firm 6-month
contract, plus 3 months of options, with Ithaca Energy for accommodation
support at the Captain field in the UK North Sea, starting in the second
quarter of 2027. 

"The fleet continues to deliver consistent strong performance, achieving 100%
commercial uptime on all operating vessels during August. 

Safe Notos' successful transition reinforces Prosafe's long-standing presence
in Brazil, one of our key markets. Thank you to everyone involved for their
commitment and teamwork during the process and we look forward to supporting
Petrobras safely and efficiently throughout this new contract with day rates
and EBITDA contribution reflecting the current tight global offshore
accommodation market," said Reese McNeel, CEO of Prosafe. 

Prosafe is a leading owner and operator of semi-submersible accommodation
vessels. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange with ticker code
PRS. For more information, please refer to https://www.prosafe.com
(https://www.prosafe.com/)  

For further information, please contact:
Reese McNeel, CEO
